summary: Celebrating our cousin, Father Tom Mitchell, who passed. He was a kindered spirit, dedicated his life to walking Christ-like path. Baptized a kid or two of mine. Cant remember exactly. We're Irish. Already a whisky or two poured in rememberance.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Celebrating our cousin, Father Tom Mitchell, who passed. He was a kindered spirit, dedicated his life to walking Christ-like path.

Baptized a kid or two of mine. Cant remember exactly. We're Irish. Already a whisky or two poured in rememberance.
